trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The merfolk can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Siren Song
entries: Lovely singing voices charm every humanoid or giant within 300 feet. The targets must succeed on a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} until the song ends.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d6}) piercing damage.

fluff.name: Crystal Cave Merfolk
entries: The Crystal Cave merfolk have long, flowing fins and silvery scales. They have lovely, melodic voices that are enhanced by the vibrating crystals of the cave in which they dwell.

They love anything silver and are willing to trade pearls and bits of gold treasure that they have found on their hunts under the waters. They also have {@item Potion of Water Breathing||magical potions} that can help a surface dweller breathe underwater.
